[00:31.00-00:35.00] FATHER THOMAS (Steady, Cold): "Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."
[00:35.80-00:39.80] CAMERA: Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.
[00:36.50-00:39.40] CATHERINE (Soft, Calculating): "Unsupervised. In your hands alone."
[00:39.80-00:43.00] CAMERA: Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.
[00:40.40-00:42.50] FATHER THOMAS (Grave): "For as long as it holds."
[00:43.00-00:48.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.
[00:43.20-00:48.00] CATHERINE (Softly, Teasing): "Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does."
[00:48.50-00:54.50] CAMERA: Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.
[00:49.80-00:54.00] FATHER THOMAS (Chuckle, Resigned): "I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again."
[00:54.50-00:59.80] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of their lips almost grazing, warm candlelight catching the edges of their profiles.
[00:54.80-00:56.50] CATHERINE (Murmuring): "In another room no one uses?"
[00:56.80-00:59.20] FATHER THOMAS (Whispering): "Perhaps I like rooms no one uses."
[00:59.80-01:05.50] CAMERA: Close-up profile as Catherine slides both hands into the dark hair at the back of his neck, pulling him closer.
[01:00.30-01:04.80] CATHERINE (Low, Carnal): "Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for."
[01:05.50-01:10.50] CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Father Thomas pulls Catherine into a fierce, suffocating embrace, burying his face in her neck while she clings to his broad shoulders.
[01:05.80-01:10.50] ACTION: Catherine closes her eyes in surrender as Father Thomas holds her tight against his naked chest, lost in their forbidden entanglement.
[01:10.50-01:13.50] CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following Agnes as she walks cautiously down the dimly lit stone corridor, holding a black iron lantern.
[01:10.80-01:13.50] ACTION: Agnes scans the desolate hallway nervously, her lantern casting elongated shadows against the wall.
[01:13.50-01:16.50] CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot behind Agnes as she stops dead in front of an open doorway, peering inside.
[01:14.00-01:16.50] ACTION: Through the crack of the door, Agnes sees Catherine and the shirtless priest locked in an intimate, passionate embrace upon the bed.
[01:16.50-01:18.50] CAMERA: Tight close-up on Agnes's face, drained of all color, her eyes bulging in pure terror.
[01:16.80-01:18.50] ACTION: Agnes's jaw drops open in shock as she stifles a cry.
[01:17.20-01:18.60] SOUND: Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.
[01:18.50-01:20.00] CAMERA: Frantic backward tracking close-up on Agnes stumbling back into the shadows of the hallway, horrified by the lethal secret she has uncovered before an abrupt cut to black.
